items.title: Approve the Minutes of the November 14, 2023 Meeting
Adopt Two 2023 Prop L 5-Year Prioritization Programs and Amend the Prop L Strategic Plan Baseline Programs: 1) Traffic Signs and Signals Maintenance, 2) Safer and Complete Streets
Allocate $36,545,335 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, for Five Requests Projects
Program $2,601,000 in Senate Bill 1 Local Partnership Program Formula Funds
Authorize the Executive Director to Execute Master Agreements, Program Supplemental Agreements, Cooperative Agreements, Fund Transfer Agreements and
Increase the Amount of Professional Services Contract with MNS Engineers, Inc. by $250,000 to a Total Amount Not to Exceed $5,050,000, for Construction Management Services End of Consent Agenda
